title: Spiced Lamb Tagine German-Style
description: A twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, this German-inspired version features richly spiced lamb and a hearty, comforting flavor profile.

ingredients.name: richly spiced egyptian lamb seasoning
ingredients.notes: see notes for spice blend recipe

ingredients.name: german beer
ingredients.notes: use a dark lager or bock beer

instructions: Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, and the richly spiced Egyptian lamb seasoning.
Heat a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb to the pot and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot, and red bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the German beer to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb and vegetables for 2-1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling apart.
Stir in the honey, if using.
Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
